components.label: Host Discovery
components.role: Establish host liveness before deeper active probes.

components.role: Identify open TCP services with bounded connect probes.

components.role: Collect service and version evidence from confirmed open ports.

components.label: TLS Inspector
components.role: Collect supported protocol, cipher, and certificate facts.

components.label: Web Fingerprint
components.role: Collect passive HTTP response, header, and technology facts.

components.label: SMB Negotiation
components.role: Collect SMB dialect support through negotiation only.

components.label: Database Fingerprint
components.role: Identify database listeners through minimal protocol handshakes.

components.label: AI / MCP Discovery
components.role: Identify exposed AI and MCP discovery endpoints without invoking tools.

components.label: UDP Service Probe
components.role: Probe selected UDP services with protocol-specific read requests.

components.label: Passive Discovery
components.role: Observe receive-only broadcast announcements and report unavailable multicast coverage.

components.label: SSH Inventory
components.role: Collect authorized Linux inventory with supplied credentials.

components.label: Windows Inventory
